title: CHORE-01: Prisma schema, migrations and Railway database
body:
Schema from the ERD, initial migration applied, DATABASE_URL via env (never committed).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] schema.prisma matches the ERD (6 tables, all relations)
- [ ] `npx prisma migrate dev` applies cleanly on an empty database
- [ ] `npx prisma db seed` loads demo data and the verify queries pass
- [ ] DATABASE_URL is read from env; `.env` is git-ignored and `.env.example` is committed
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: CHORE-02: Project board, labels and README conventions
body:
Branch naming, PR rules, Definition of Done and env-variable notes in the README; board set up and loaded with the backlog.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] README has branch naming, PR rules, Definition of Done and Environment variables
- [ ] Board is public with columns Backlog, To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done
- [ ] All backlog issues are on the board with labels and milestones
- [ ] Repo link and board link submitted on Discord
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-001: Create client with one vehicle
body:
The system must create a client with name, mobile number, and one vehicle (plate number, make, model) when an employee submits the new-client form with all fields filled, and must save the mobile number in international format (961 + number, without leading 0).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Submitting all fields creates one client and one linked vehicle
- [ ] Submitting with any field empty shows a message and saves nothing
- [ ] Mobile `03123456` is saved as `9613123456`; `71898929` as `96171898929`
- [ ] A duplicate plate number is rejected with a clear message
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-002: Edit client name or mobile number
body:
The system must update a client's name or mobile number when an employee saves changes on the client's profile.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Saving a new name updates it on the profile and the dashboard
- [ ] A new mobile number is saved in 961 format
- [ ] An empty name or invalid mobile is rejected with a message
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-006: Log a service record
body:
The system must save a service record (service type, service date today or earlier, odometer) for a vehicle when an employee submits the log-service form.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Form asks for service type, date and odometer
- [ ] A date of today or earlier is accepted; a future date is rejected
- [ ] Odometer must be a positive whole number
- [ ] After saving, a row exists in service_records for that vehicle
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-007: Calculate next due date on service save
body:
The system must set the vehicle's next due date for a service type to service date + the type's interval in months when a service record is saved. Depends on FR-008.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Oil change (6 months) logged on 2026-04-14 gives due date 2026-10-14
- [ ] Logging the same type again updates the existing reminder instead of creating a duplicate
- [ ] Month ends are handled (31 Aug + 6 months = 28 Feb)
- [ ] The reminder points to the new service record (last_service_record_id)
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-008: Create service types with interval
body:
The system must let an employee create a service type with a name and a reminder interval in months.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Form takes a name and an interval in months (whole number, at least 1)
- [ ] A saved type appears in the log-service dropdown
- [ ] An empty name or an interval below 1 is rejected
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-011: Dashboard of due and overdue vehicles
body:
The system must list every active vehicle whose next due date is within 7 days or already past, showing client name, mobile, plate, service type, due date and contacted date, most overdue first.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Shows reminders due within 7 days or overdue
- [ ] Each row shows client name, mobile, plate, service type, due date and contacted date (empty if none)
- [ ] Sorted most overdue first
- [ ] A reminder due in 8+ days and vehicles of inactive clients are not shown
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-015a: Login with email and password
body:
The system must sign a user in when they submit a registered email and its correct password (single shared workshop account).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Registered email and correct password signs in and opens the dashboard
- [ ] Any other page redirects to the login page when signed out
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-015b: Generic login error message
body:
The system must show 'email or password is incorrect' without saying which one when either is wrong.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A wrong password shows exactly: email or password is incorrect
- [ ] An unknown email shows the same message
- [ ] Nothing on the page reveals which of the two was wrong
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-017: Mark reminder as contacted
body:
The system must save today's date as the contacted date on a reminder when an employee taps 'Mark contacted' on the dashboard row.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Tapping 'Mark contacted' saves today's date in contacted_date
- [ ] The row stays on the dashboard and shows the contacted date
- [ ] The row leaves the dashboard only after a new service is logged (FR-007)
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-001: Dashboard loads in under 3s on 4G
body:
Dashboard loads in under 3 seconds on a 4G mobile connection with 2,000 clients stored.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Database seeded with 2,000 clients
- [ ] Chrome DevTools throttled to Fast 4G: dashboard fully loads in under 3 seconds on 3 runs
- [ ] Result recorded in the issue
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-002: 95% of API responses under 500ms
body:
95% of API responses return in under 500ms with 10 concurrent users.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Load test (k6 or autocannon) with 10 concurrent users
- [ ] p95 response time is under 500ms
- [ ] Test command and result recorded in the issue
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-003/011: Capacity target: 5,000 clients
body:
Meet NFR-001 and NFR-002 with 5,000 clients, 8,000 vehicles, 50,000 service records and 10 concurrent users.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Bulk seed script creates 5,000 clients, 8,000 vehicles, 50,000 service records
- [ ] NFR-001 and NFR-002 tests pass on that data
- [ ] Missing indexes added if a test fails
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-004: Daily automatic backups + monthly restore test
body:
Automatic database backup every 24h; restorable from latest backup within 1 hour; restore test verified monthly.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Automatic daily backups are enabled on the hosting database
- [ ] Restore steps are written in the README or docs
- [ ] A restore test on a copy completes in under 1 hour and is logged
- [ ] A monthly reminder for the restore test exists
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-005: Show save-failed message and keep form input
body:
When a database request fails, show a message that the record was not saved and keep what the employee typed.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] With the database unreachable, submitting a form shows a 'record was not saved' message
- [ ] All typed values stay in the form
- [ ] No success message is shown on failure
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-006: HTTPS only
body:
All client-server communication must use HTTPS.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] The deployed app is served over HTTPS with a valid certificate
- [ ] http:// requests redirect to https://
- [ ] No mixed-content warnings in the browser console
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-007: Hash passwords with bcrypt
body:
User passwords must be stored hashed using bcrypt.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] users.password_hash values start with $2 (bcrypt)
- [ ] No plain-text password in the database, code, logs or seed output
- [ ] Login compares with bcrypt.compare
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-008: Session expires after 12h inactivity
body:
End a session after 12 hours of inactivity.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Session lifetime is configured to 12 hours of inactivity
- [ ] With the lifetime shortened for a test, an expired session redirects to login
- [ ] Activity extends the session
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-009a: Parameterized queries only
body:
Every database query is parameterized, no user input concatenated into SQL; verified by code review.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] All queries use the Prisma client or parameterized values
- [ ] grep finds no $queryRawUnsafe and no SQL built by string concatenation
- [ ] Reviewer ticks this in the PR
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-009b: Escape user-entered text on display
body:
Escape all user text before display so a client name with a script tag renders as plain text.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A client named <script>alert(1)</script> shows as plain text on the dashboard, profile and search results
- [ ] No alert fires and no HTML is injected
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-010: Client data only for authenticated users
body:
Client data must only be accessible to an authenticated user (logged-out request to a client page must fail).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A logged-out request to a client page redirects to login
- [ ] A logged-out request to any API route returns 401 and no data
- [ ] Checked for every route that returns client data
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-013: New employee onboarding under 5 minutes
body:
A new employee can register a client and log a service in under 5 minutes with no docs.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A person who never saw the app registers a client and logs a service in under 5 minutes, timed with a stopwatch
- [ ] No documentation or help given during the test
- [ ] Result recorded; if it fails, promote FR-004 (search) to v1
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-015: No horizontal scroll at 375px
body:
Dashboard and log-service form display without horizontal scrolling on a 375px-wide screen.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] In DevTools at 375px width, the dashboard has no horizontal scrollbar
- [ ] Same for the log-service form
- [ ] All buttons and text are reachable
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-018: Browser support: latest two major versions
body:
Pass all v1 acceptance tests on latest two major versions of the browsers [TO CONFIRM WITH OWNER], desktop and mobile.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Owner confirms which browsers and phones they use; the list is written in this issue
- [ ] All v1 acceptance tests pass on the latest two major versions of each, desktop and mobile
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-003: Deactivate client (keep history)
body:
Mark a client inactive and remove their vehicles from the dashboard, keeping service history, when an employee confirms.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A confirmation dialog appears before deactivating
- [ ] The client is marked is_active = false, not deleted
- [ ] Their vehicles no longer appear on the dashboard
- [ ] Their service records are still in the database
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-004: Search clients by name, mobile or plate
body:
List every client whose name, mobile or plate contains the search text when at least 2 characters are typed. Promote to v1 if NFR-013 fails without it.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Search starts at 2 characters; 1 character does nothing
- [ ] Matches name, mobile or plate number that contains the text, case-insensitive
- [ ] No match shows a 'no results' message
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-005: Add vehicle to existing client
body:
Add a vehicle (plate, make, model) to an existing client via the add-vehicle form on the client's profile.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Add-vehicle form is on the client's profile
- [ ] The new vehicle is linked to that client and shown on the profile
- [ ] A duplicate plate number is rejected
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-012: Change a reminder's due date
body:
Change the next due date for a service type to the date the employee picks when they save it on the reminder.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Picking a date and saving updates the reminder's due date
- [ ] The dashboard shows the new date and position
- [ ] An empty or invalid date is rejected
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-013: Service history list per vehicle
body:
List every service record for a vehicle, newest first, with date, service type and odometer, on the vehicle's page.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Vehicle page lists all its service records, newest first
- [ ] Each row shows date, service type and odometer
- [ ] A vehicle with no records shows an empty-state message
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-018: WhatsApp deep-link reminder button
body:
Generate wa.me/<mobile>?text=<message with plate, service type, due date> that opens WhatsApp prefilled when the employee taps 'Send on WhatsApp'. Depends on FR-001 international format.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Each due or overdue dashboard row has a 'Send on WhatsApp' button
- [ ] The link is wa.me/<961 number>?text=<URL-encoded message> with plate, service type and due date
- [ ] Tapping it opens WhatsApp with the message prefilled
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-016: Service-layer test coverage above 60%
body:
Test coverage on the service layer must be above 60%.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Coverage report shows the service layer above 60%
- [ ] The test command is documented in the README
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: FR-014: Export vehicle service history as PDF
body:
Generate a PDF of a vehicle's service history with workshop name and plate number at the top when Export is clicked.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Clicking Export downloads a PDF
- [ ] Workshop name and plate number are at the top
- [ ] Service records are listed newest first
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-020: Keyboard navigable UI
body:
All interactive elements must be keyboard-navigable.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Every button, link and form control can be reached with Tab
- [ ] Focus is visible, Enter and Space activate controls
- [ ] No keyboard traps
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)

title: NFR-021: WCAG AA color contrast
body:
Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Every text/background pair is at least 4.5:1, checked with a contrast tool or Lighthouse
- [ ] Failures are fixed or listed in the issue
- [ ] Meets the Definition of Done (see README)
